name: transfer_comparison
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file
method: One row per case. The transfer case's card is built by mva.drugs.transfer.transfer_card from the committed spec plus the HPO terms for its OMIM id read out of phenotype.hpoa (release 2026-09-02; rows whose qualifier column is NOT are skipped). The same mva-drugs snapshot and mva.drugs.enrich.run then execute on it with no code change and no hand-written query. Counts are read back from each case's snapshot.json (targets, candidate rows, distinct approved drugs, per-source request counts) and its enrichment analysis (drugs at each best rung, shortlist and do-not row counts, per-source request counts); cached_replies is replies minus live, summed over both stages. Every count on a transfer row comes from the COLD pass - the one that filled the cache - so it states what a case the pipeline has never seen costs; wall_seconds is that pass's measured snapshot+enrichment wall clock and warm_seconds a second pass over the warm cache, which is re-derivation rather than a new case. Both are empty for a case this run did not execute. Only the automated rungs (1, 4, 5) are comparable: rungs 2 and 3 come from a hand-curated evidence.tsv that a transfer card does not have, which is what curated_rows records.
known_gap: the two enrichment analyses this table reads its rung counts, request counts and wall clock from live under build/ and are not committed: build/track2/analysis.json and build/track2/transfer-TRIP13-analysis.json. Every count in them is reproducible from the committed tables named above by re-running `uv run python tools/track2_enrich.py --skip-live` per folder; the wall clock is a measurement of one machine on one day and is not reproducible by construction. The HPO annotation the transfer card's clinical terms were read from (build/reference-scratch/phenotype.hpoa, release 2026-09-02) is a downloaded public reference under build/ as well; the card records the release it was read at.
patient_data: none, on either row. The transfer case is public annotation (OMIM, MONDO, HPO, PubMed) and asserts no allele in any person; the real case's row carries counts only. No genomic position appears in any column by construction.
